purpose: D1 correction: execution-layer typed structured output via codex exec --output-schema. Every Stage-Q v3 judge call binds one of these JSON Schemas so the FINAL response is constrained at the execution layer.

toolingConstraintProven.finding: codex exec --output-schema uses OpenAI STRICT structured-outputs (response_format json_schema). A pre-seal live probe returned HTTP 400 invalid_json_schema on the original schemas: it requires every property to carry an explicit 'type' key (bare 'const'/'enum' rejected), requires ALL properties in 'required' (no optional fields), and does NOT support 'minLength'.
toolingConstraintProven.resolution: Schemas use the strict subset: const→{type:string,enum:[value]}, every enum carries type:string, ALL properties required (candidate defectClass is required; the judge emits 'NONE' when clean), and 'minLength:1' is REMOVED from the schema and enforced at the code layer (the runner rejects any empty evidenceSpans string — the owner's non-empty-span intent, preserved). A second live probe with the strict-subset review schema returned a schema-conforming object with evidenceSpans as a real JSON array.
toolingConstraintProven.semanticsPreserved: typed structured output; evidenceSpans is a real array (stringified arrays structurally impossible); unknown fields / missing required / invalid enum rejected at the execution layer; empty spans rejected at the code layer. The v2 evidenceSpans-as-string failure mode cannot recur.

brokerMechanism.central: src/orchestrator/codexAgent.ts outputSchemaPath → executionEnvelope hermeticExecArgv --output-schema; structured-output sidecar per spawn; ChatGPT-subscription route.
